name: What is the difference between a custom mantel and a pre-fabricated mantel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom mantel and a pre-fabricated mantel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference lies in customization and fit. A pre-fabricated mantel is a mass-produced unit available in standard sizes and designs, offering a quicker and often more budget-friendly option. However, it may require adjustments to your fireplace opening or wall to fit properly, and design choices are limited. A custom mantel, on the other hand, is built precisely to your specifications and the exact dimensions of your fireplace, ensuring a seamless and unique look. The practical tradeoff is between immediate availability and cost-effectiveness versus tailored design and perfect integration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom mantels are built to exact specifications for a unique fit and design, while pre-fabricated ones are standard sizes, often requiring adjustments.
